reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the fluorine treatment from Ti-45Al-8.5Nb (P1, P2, P9, P10) to HfNbTaTiZr, but the alloy chemistry is fundamentally different (no Al, refractory BCC vs. γ-TiAl), and the predicted protective scale (HfO2, Ta2O5, TiO2) is not the Al2O3 scale reported in the passages. The proposal lacks a stated mechanism for why fluorine would work without Al and does not integrate any evidence from the HfNbTaTiZr literature to justify the transfer.
copied_elements: mechanism: fluorine-induced formation of protective oxide layer
